The official OpenAI deprecations page is the authoritative source, but the search only returned fragments of it, and third-party sites give dates the fragments don't confirm.

**From the official page (partial excerpts):**
- GPT Image models are slated for removal on December 1, 2026. The listed models are gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5, and chatgpt-image-latest, with gpt-image-2 as the replacement. OpenAI notified developers on June 2, 2026 of that removal date.
- The gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest snapshots are scheduled to shut down on August 10, 2026, with gpt-5.5 as the recommended replacement.
- For fine-tuning, starting July 2, 2026, creating fine-tuning jobs is no longer available to organizations that have not run inference on a fine-tuned model in the past 60 days.

**From third-party sites (unverified against the official page):**
- One guide says the October 23, 2026 retirement covers gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo, o1, and o4-mini. A second source lists the same October 23 cluster, adds gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o3-mini, and gpt-image-1, and says it is mostly replaced by the GPT-5.6 tiers and gpt-image-2.
- Another guide reports that the Assistants API shuts down August 26, 2026, with the Responses API and Conversations API as named replacements.
- A third source lists GPT-5 and o3 snapshots on December 11, 2026, and the legacy audio and realtime family on January 20, 2027.
- A July 2026 article notes that OpenAI's published notice policy is at least six months for generally available models and at least three months for specialized variants such as Codex and chat-latest models.

**Caveats:** The official excerpts I could see did not include the October 23 or Assistants API entries, so those dates rest on third-party guides. Some of those guides also disagree with each other about which models fall in each batch. Check developers.openai.com/docs/deprecations directly before relying on any date.

The official page is OpenAI's deprecations page at https://developers.openai.com/docs/deprecations. It was formerly at platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations. I couldn't open it directly because my fetch tool's connection was refused. Everything below comes from search-result excerpts, so check the page itself before relying on any date.

Today is 2026-10-16. The next retirements, soonest first:

1. **October 23, 2026** (a week away): gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo, o1 and o4-mini. One source also lists gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o3-mini and gpt-image-1. This date comes only from third-party guides, which disagree on which models are in the batch. The official excerpts I saw didn't include it.
2. **December 1, 2026**: gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest, replaced by gpt-image-2. This is from the official page.
3. **December 11, 2026**: GPT-5 and o3 snapshots. Third-party source only.
4. **January 20, 2027**: the legacy audio and realtime family. Third-party source only.

Some dates have probably already passed, such as the gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest shutdown on August 10, 2026. The Assistants API shutdown on August 26, 2026 is third-party only.
